verdict.rationale: Godot has documented headless mode with a dedicated headless display server and Dummy audio driver for running on GPU-less/dedicated-server machines, plus a full command-line tutorial for scripted/CI workflows (exporting, running scenes, etc.), which together support CI automation use cases. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/GitHub Actions examples and independent hands-on confirmation of CI pipelines using headless Godot.
